description: How many companies match an ICP, and what pulling them would cost. Free: this call never spends credits. The first step before search_companies. As with count_leads, a realtime count costs $0.04 at the Tier 0 list price and runs only when mode:"realtime" is passed explicitly.

allow_unlisted_values.description: Escape hatch for the local vocabulary check — see the lead-side field of the same name.

company_names.description: Restrict to specific company names — realtime only: using it forces the pricier live mode.

company_types.description: Company types: "Public Company","Privately Held","Non Profit","Government Agency","Educational", …

department_headcount.description: Department size, e.g. {"name":"engineering","min":10,"max":100} — realtime only: using it forces the pricier live mode.

exclude_domains.description: Exclude companies by domain (e.g. existing customers).

fallback_from_leads.description: DEPRECATED — accepted but ignored. Removed. It fabricated lead-derived name aggregates and cost an extra billable query.

get_max_companies.description: DEPRECATED — accepted but ignored. Always on now: search responses include results_count without asking.

headcount_growth.description: Headcount growth in percent — realtime only: using it forces the pricier live mode.

hiring_on_linkedin.description: Only companies actively hiring — realtime only: using it forces the pricier live mode.

industries.description: Company industries. Must match Generect industry names exactly (e.g. "Software Development"); unknown names are rejected with HTTP 400.

keywords.description: Free-text keywords across name/description/specialties — realtime only: using it forces the pricier live mode.

linkedins_links.description: Specific LinkedIn company URLs — realtime only: using it forces the pricier live mode.

locations.description: HQ locations — cities, states or countries.

mode.description: Data mode. "database" = Generect's own index: sub-second, free counts, free thin rows (see detail) or cheaper full rows; it accepts a subset of the filters today and names any it rejects. "realtime" = live LinkedIn lookup, 5–60s, billed per row, accepts every realtime filter. "auto" (default) tries database first and escalates to realtime only if a filter you passed is rejected there (the escalation is reported, and is refused above the per-call spend ceiling). Pick "database" explicitly when you only need a size estimate and cost matters more than freshness.

num_of_followers.description: LinkedIn follower buckets: "1-50","51-100","101-1000","1001-5000","5001+" — realtime only: using it forces the pricier live mode.

revenues_range.description: Annual revenue range, single object {min,max} — realtime only: using it forces the pricier live mode.

sub_industries.description: Expand each selected industry to its sub-industries as well (broadens the match).

technologies.description: Technologies the company uses — realtime only: using it forces the pricier live mode.

name: count_companies
title: Count matching companies (free)
